taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: Drawn as a forb on the herb program: Abrams (1944 p. 434) gives "Stems from a scaly branching rootstock, slender, 15-30 cm. high" over long-stalked basal leaves. No Rosaceae forb is built in, so its template is showy Jacob's-ladder (polemonium-pulcherrimum), another subalpine forb with a tuft of divided basal leaves under few-flowered stems.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: "Stems from a scaly branching rootstock, slender, 15-30 cm. high".

traits.life_span.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: stems "from a scaly branching rootstock": a perennial.

traits.perennation.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: "from a scaly branching rootstock".

traits.rosette.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: "Basal leaves usually with long slender petioles".

traits.leaf_division.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: basal leaves "ternate".

traits.division_pattern.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: basal leaves "ternate": three leaflets from one point.

traits.division_order.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: "ternate", the leaflets "deeply incised-serrate" but not divided again.

traits.leaflets.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: basal leaves "ternate".

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: basal leaves 4 cm to 12 cm long with their petioles, as in the photos; Abrams gives no length.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: petioles 3 cm to 10 cm long; Abrams (1944 p. 434): "usually with long slender petioles".

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: leaflets 1.5 cm to 3.5 cm long, as in the photos.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: "leaflets cuneate-flabelliform", fan-shaped and widest near the tip; read as obovate.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: leaflets "deeply incised-serrate".

traits.cauline_leaves.note: Stem leaves few and smaller than the basal ones, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 145624511, 40901066, 296521191, 8438199, 182887878, 366919469, 392046, 232901042): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.stem_hairs.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: stems "minutely puberulent".

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: "cymes few-flowered".

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: One to five flowers to a stem; Abrams (1944 p. 434): "cymes few-flowered", set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 145624511, 40901066, 296521191, 8438199, 182887878, 366919469, 392046, 232901042): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Five petals to a flower, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 145624511, 40901066, 296521191, 8438199, 182887878, 366919469, 392046, 232901042): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: "petals yellow, 8-10 mm. long".

traits.sepal_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: "sepals ovate, acute, 5-6 mm. long".

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: open flowers 1.8 cm to 2.5 cm across, a little over twice the 8-10 mm petals Abrams gives, as in the photos.

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 434, Potentilla flabellifolia: "petals yellow"; sRGB by eye from the photos (a warm, bright yellow).

traits.fruit_type.note: Achenes, as in Abrams's key to Potentilleae (1944 p. 408): "Fruit of indehiscent achenes", "Ovaries 1-ovuled"; the species account does not describe its fruit.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for fan-leaf cinquefoil from Abrams's description and the photos the traits cite, on showy Jacob's-ladder's (polemonium-pulcherrimum) structure: a tuft of six long-stalked, three-parted basal leaves, a few slender stems with two small leaves each, ending in one to five yellow flowers on short stalks (Abrams 1944 p. 434). Not fitted to measurements.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: a low tuft of long-stalked leaves of three fan-shaped, deeply toothed leaflets under slender stems with a few bright yellow, five-petalled flowers. Organ cards from showy Jacob's-ladder's (polemonium-pulcherrimum), recoloured and resized by hand. Colours set by eye were written as screen (sRGB) shades; they are read as the linear light a colour field holds, and bark and foliage follow the stated colour traits by rule (2026-10-19).

allometry.note: 0.22 m tall at 3 years in the open, within its sources' range, as it grows in subalpine parkland. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
